gloss: loud sound; great noise; thunderous volume

definitions.gloss: loud sound; great noise; thunderous volume
definitions.explanation: An extremely loud sound or noise, emphasizing the overwhelming volume or intensity of the auditory impact.

examples.japanese: {大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}った→響き渡る：15059_hibikiwataru⟧。
examples.english: A thunderous sound echoed all around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Fireworks shot up into the night sky with a tremendous boom.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{耳|みみ}{栓|せん}→耳栓：23409_mimisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: At the concert venue, many people were wearing earplugs because of the extreme volume.

notes:
Composed of {大|だい} (great; large) + ⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧ (sound; acoustics). Describes a sound that is overwhelmingly loud, often to the point of being physically felt. Used in both literal descriptions of noise and more dramatic, literary depictions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧: a great sound reverberates
- {大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧: with a great roar
- {大|だい}{音響|おんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to make a great noise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{轟音|ごうおん}→轟音：14309_gouon⟧: roaring sound; thundering noise — emphasizes a rumbling, resonating quality
- ⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧: noise; noise pollution — implies unwanted or disturbing sound
- ⟦{爆音|ばくおん}→爆音：15070_bakuon⟧: explosive sound — specifically the sound of explosions, engines, or similar blasts
